SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM (
  SELECT i.ref_id
  FROM items_g2 i
  JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id
  WHERE i.prc_usd > 50
  GROUP BY i.ref_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND AVG(f.rtg) < 3.0
);

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.prc_usd > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prc_usd_gt50,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.prc > 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prc_gt5000,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.prc_usd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_prc_usd
FROM items_g2 i;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_prc,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_usd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prc_only,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NULL AND prc > 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prc_only_gt50,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL AND ABS(prc/100.0 - prc_usd) > 0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch
FROM items_g2;
SELECT prc, prc_usd FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NULL AND prc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY prc DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM (
  SELECT i.ref_id
  FROM items_g2 i
  JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id
  WHERE i.prc > 5000
  GROUP BY i.ref_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND AVG(f.rtg) < 3.0
);

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN cnt>=5 AND avgr<3.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS result
FROM (
  SELECT i.ref_id, COUNT(*) cnt, AVG(f.rtg) avgr, i.prc, i.prc_usd
  FROM items_g2 i JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id
  WHERE i.prc > 5000
  GROUP BY i.ref_id
) t;

SELECT t.ref_id, t.cnt, ROUND(t.avgr,3) AS avg_from_reviews, t.stored_avg, ROUND(t.prc/100.0,2) AS usd
FROM (
  SELECT i.ref_id, i.avg_rtg AS stored_avg, i.prc, COUNT(*) cnt, AVG(f.rtg) avgr
  FROM items_g2 i JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id
  WHERE i.prc > 5000
  GROUP BY i.ref_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND AVG(f.rtg) < 3.0
) t
ORDER BY t.avgr;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS using_stored_avg
FROM (
  SELECT i.ref_id, COUNT(*) cnt
  FROM items_g2 i JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id
  WHERE i.prc > 5000
  GROUP BY i.ref_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND i.avg_rtg < 3.0
);
